description: This file defines the 'AttributeType' interface, which is a part of the OpenMRS core project. It specifies a generic interface for user-defined extensions for core domain objects related to attributes, including relevant metadata and customization capabilities.

classes.name: AttributeType
classes.description: A generic interface representing attribute types associated with customizable objects in OpenMRS, supporting repeated custom values and metadata.

methods.name: AttributeType
methods.description: Interface declaration for attribute types with a generic owning type that extends Customizable.
